Players Committee card image of [[Bossk (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While at same site as a smuggler, power +3. While with opponent's smuggler or Wookiee, opponent may not draw more than one battle destiny here. Immune to attrition < number of opponent's smugglers on table.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/bossk.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
